categories.name: Immigration case management
categories.description: Forms, case tracking, deadlines and client portals built for immigration law firms.

categories.name: Immigration CRM for consultants
categories.description: Lead-to-visa pipelines for RCICs, migration agents and visa consultancies.

categories.name: Law practice management
categories.description: General legal practice suites — matters, billing, documents — that immigration firms also run on.

categories.name: AI for immigration law
categories.description: AI drafting, research and case preparation tools for petitions, briefs and RFE responses.

categories.name: Corporate immigration & global mobility
categories.description: Platforms employers and their counsel use to manage work authorisation across a workforce.

categories.name: General CRMs used by immigration firms
categories.description: Mainstream sales CRMs that consultancies adapt for enquiries and follow-ups.

software.name: AbacusLaw
software.tagline: Long-standing practice management for law firms.
software.description: AbacusLaw is practice management software from Abacus Data Systems covering calendaring, matters, billing and accounting.

software.name: Actionstep
software.tagline: Workflow-driven legal practice management.
software.description: Actionstep is cloud legal practice management with configurable matter workflows, document management and integrated accounting.

software.name: Agentcis
software.tagline: CRM for education and migration agencies.
software.description: Agentcis is a cloud CRM for education and migration agencies, covering leads, client applications, sub-agents, finance and classroom (IELTS/PTE) management, with mobile apps.

software.name: Amberlo
software.tagline: Law practice management for firms of all sizes.
software.description: Amberlo is law practice management software covering matters, time tracking, billing and documents.

software.name: CaseBlink
software.tagline: AI case preparation and drafting studio for immigration attorneys.
software.description: CaseBlink is an AI platform for immigration case preparation, combining document understanding, automated research and a customizable drafting tool called Studio.

software.name: CaseEasy
software.tagline: Case management for Canadian immigration consultants and lawyers.
software.description: CaseEasy is cloud case management for Registered Canadian Immigration Consultants and immigration lawyers, founded in Toronto in 2017. It covers client management, a client portal with document sharing, communication, tasks and workflows, invoicing with Stripe and LawPay payments, retainer automation and IRCC forms. Pricing starts at CA$79 per user per month, with a free version.

software.name: Centerbase
software.tagline: Practice management for growing law firms.
software.description: Centerbase is cloud legal practice management covering matters, billing and reporting.

software.name: Clio
software.tagline: Cloud legal practice management for small and mid-sized firms.
software.description: Clio is a widely used cloud practice management platform covering matters, client intake, time and billing, documents and client collaboration, with a large integration marketplace. Many immigration firms pair it with a forms tool.

software.name: Complize
software.tagline: Immigration software listed among popular case management tools.
software.description: Complize is immigration software listed in several directories alongside the main immigration case management tools. The vendor can claim this listing to add details.

software.name: CosmoLex
software.tagline: Practice management with built-in legal accounting.
software.description: CosmoLex combines legal practice management, billing and trust accounting in a single application.

software.name: CRMtravel Visa Management
software.tagline: Visa application CRM for travel agencies and visa consultants.
software.description: CRMtravel's visa management software automates visa applications, document tracking and client communication for travel agencies, visa consultants and immigration firms.

software.name: Docketwise
software.tagline: Immigration case management with a large USCIS forms library.
software.description: Docketwise is case management software for US immigration attorneys. It centres on smart forms that reuse client answers across USCIS filings, alongside a client portal, to-do lists, invoicing and e-signatures. It is part of the 8am legal software family.

software.name: DraftyAI
software.tagline: AI case prep for US immigration lawyers.
software.description: DraftyAI is an AI case preparation platform for US immigration lawyers, covering declarations, petitions, waivers, asylum and removal-defence briefs, BIA appeals, motions and RFE/NOID responses.

software.name: eImmigration
software.tagline: Immigration case management for law practices and nonprofits.
software.description: eImmigration is case management software for immigration casework at law practices and nonprofit organisations, covering cases, documents, data and notes with an emphasis on workflow automation.
software.pricingNote: $55, $82 or $100 per user/month billed annually; 50% off for non-profits

software.name: Envoy Global
software.tagline: Corporate immigration platform with legal services.
software.description: Envoy Global is a corporate immigration and global mobility platform for HR and legal teams, combining case workflows, document collection and compliance tracking with access to immigration legal services.

software.name: Ezymigrate
software.tagline: CRM for migration agents and immigration lawyers.
software.description: Ezymigrate is a CRM built for migration agents, covering the client journey from enquiry to visa lodgement, with document checklists, auto-generated agreements, time tracking and reporting. It integrates with Xero and Mailchimp.

software.name: Filevine
software.tagline: Configurable legal case management with AI assistance.
software.description: Filevine is legal case management software with configurable workflows, document handling, client communication tools and AI assistance.

software.name: HubSpot CRM
software.tagline: Marketing and sales CRM for scaling consultancies.
software.description: HubSpot CRM is a general sales and marketing CRM that larger consultancies use for lead capture, nurturing and pipelines.

software.name: Imagility
software.tagline: Petition building, AI analysis and e-filing for business immigration.
software.description: Imagility is a cloud immigration platform for attorneys, employers and beneficiaries. It builds petitions for employment categories (H-1B, L, O, E, TN, I-140 and green cards) and, per the vendor, family and asylum cases, with AI petition analysis, an RFE response builder, petition tracking, invoicing through LawPay and an e-filing connector for USCIS forms such as I-129, G-28, I-907 and Labor Condition Applications.

software.name: ImmiCompliance
software.tagline: Cloud practice and case management for immigration firms.
software.description: ImmiCompliance is cloud-based practice and case management for immigration and other law firms. It groups the forms needed for a given visa type and is often described as one of the more affordable options in the category.

software.name: Immigence OS
software.tagline: AI-assisted CRM for Canadian immigration consultants.
software.description: Immigence OS is a CRM for RCICs, immigration consultants and lawyers in Canada, combining client and case management with CRS simulation, PNP matching and Express Entry insights.

software.name: ImmigrationTracker
software.tagline: Immigration case tracking with digital case assembly.
software.description: ImmigrationTracker is Mitratech's immigration case management product for law firms and corporate mobility teams, with automated reminders, real-time reporting on expirations and deliverables, and a shared workspace for legal staff, HR and foreign nationals.

software.name: ImmiPractice
software.tagline: Immigration CRM and practice management for Canadian immigration consultants.
software.description: ImmiPractice is a Canadian immigration CRM and practice management platform for RCICs, independent immigration consultants and immigration law firms. It covers lead capture from websites and Meta lead ads, client intake and onboarding, appointment scheduling, retainer agreements with e-signature, case and task workflows, document checklists and collection, IRCC form filling, WhatsApp and email communication, a client portal, invoicing and payments, staff management, automated follow-ups and reporting.

software.name: INSZoom
software.tagline: Enterprise immigration case management for law firms and corporations.
software.description: INSZoom is a long-established immigration case management platform owned by Mitratech. It covers the case lifecycle from intake through approval for US and Canadian matters, and Mitratech has been adding AI features and partner integrations to it.

software.name: Lawcus
software.tagline: Case management with automated workflows and billing.
software.description: Lawcus helps small and mid-sized legal teams with case management, automated workflows, integrated billing and secure client communication.

software.name: LawLogix
software.tagline: I-9 compliance and immigration case management.
software.description: LawLogix provides electronic I-9 and immigration case management software for employers and immigration counsel.

software.name: LollyLaw
software.tagline: Immigration practice management with configurable case workflows.
software.description: LollyLaw is practice management software built specifically for immigration law firms, combining a forms library with customizable workflows, client intake, billing and client communication.

software.name: Maple CRM
software.tagline: Lead, case and billing management for immigration consultants.
software.description: Maple CRM is an all-in-one CRM for immigration and education consultants, used by RCICs and visa agencies across several countries. It covers enquiries, assessment and intake forms, agreements, document checklists, a white-labelled client portal, invoicing, and generation of common IRCC forms from portal data.

software.name: Matter for Immigration
software.tagline: Case and data collection for Australian MARA agents.
software.description: Matter, by Neudash, is case management built for Australian registered migration agents. It focuses on collecting client data and documents through tailored forms and keeping each matter's details and communication in one hub.

software.name: Migration Manager
software.tagline: Practice software for Australian migration cases.
software.description: Migration Manager is practice management software for Australian migration agents, known for a large library of migration-specific templates.

software.name: MyCase
software.tagline: Legal practice management with client communication built in.
software.description: MyCase is legal practice and case management software covering intake, client communication, case management and billing, now part of the 8am family alongside Docketwise.

software.name: Officio
software.tagline: Client file management and forms for Canadian immigration professionals.
software.description: Officio is cloud-based client file management software for Canadian immigration consultants and lawyers. It automates data entry across more than 400 Canadian immigration forms and includes a client portal for document uploads and forms, client and case management with automated reminders, prospect assessment, billing with trust account management, branded templates and an AI writing assistant.

software.name: OnlineVisas
software.tagline: AI-guided immigration petition preparation.
software.description: OnlineVisas is an AI-powered petition preparation platform for law firms and corporations, with visa petition templates and checklists, case management and a client portal. It is backed by the Velie Law Firm.

software.name: Parley AI
software.tagline: AI drafting for employment-based immigration petitions.
software.description: Parley AI is an AI legal writing platform for US immigration law firms and corporate immigration teams. It drafts petitions, reference letters, attorney briefs, RFE responses and exhibit packets for categories such as O-1, EB-1, EB-2 NIW, H-1B and L-1, as a web app and a Microsoft Word add-in.

software.name: Pipedrive
software.tagline: Simple pipeline CRM for small practices.
software.description: Pipedrive is a pipeline-focused sales CRM that solo consultants and small practices use to track enquiries case by case.

software.name: PracticePanther
software.tagline: Practice management focused on ease of use.
software.description: PracticePanther is all-in-one law practice management for solo to mid-sized firms, covering cases, billing and client communication with customizable workflows.

software.name: Rocket Matter
software.tagline: Legal billing and practice management.
software.description: Rocket Matter is cloud legal practice management with a strong focus on time, billing and payments.

software.name: Smokeball
software.tagline: Practice management with automatic time tracking.
software.description: Smokeball is law practice management software used by attorneys, paralegals and staff, combining matters, documents, automatic time capture and billing.

software.name: US Immigration AI
software.tagline: AI automation for immigration firm operations.
software.description: US Immigration AI is a Los Angeles-based platform founded in 2025 that applies AI across immigration firm operations, from client intake to case readiness.

software.name: VisaFlo
software.tagline: IMM forms, IRCC portal autofill and intake for Canadian immigration practices.
software.description: VisaFlo is Canadian immigration software for RCICs and their teams. It generates IMM form packages from case-specific intake questionnaires (13 languages), lets the practitioner review and lock client answers, autofills supported IRCC portals through a Chrome extension (beta), and handles agreements with e-signature, Stripe invoicing and QuickBooks-ready exports. Pricing is based on case volume with unlimited users, and client data is hosted in Canada.

software.name: Visalaw.ai
software.tagline: AI research and drafting built for immigration law.
software.description: Visalaw.ai centralises immigration research, legal analysis and petition drafting, built on a large curated set of immigration records. It supports business, family and humanitarian process types and integrates with INSZoom.

software.name: Zoho CRM
software.tagline: Customisable CRM popular with budget-conscious agencies.
software.description: Zoho CRM is a general-purpose CRM that many immigration consultancies customise for enquiry pipelines, especially in cost-sensitive markets like India.
